original_prompt: Create a Kubernetes Pod manifest for an nginx container with a securityContext that drops all capabilities, runs as a non-root user, and uses a read-only root filesystem.
user_message_sent:
Target IaC language: Kubernetes manifest (YAML)

Task: Create a Kubernetes Pod manifest for an nginx container with a securityContext that drops all capabilities, runs as a non-root user, and uses a read-only root filesystem.

Output only the Kubernetes manifest (YAML) code, no commentary or markdown fences.
raw_response:
apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata:
  name: secure-nginx
spec:
  containers:
  - name: nginx
    image: nginx:latest
    securityContext:
      runAsNonRoot: true
      runAsUser: 101
      runAsGroup: 101
      capabilities:
        drop:
        - ALL
      readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
    volumeMounts:
    - name: tmp-volume
      mountPath: /tmp
    - name: var-cache-nginx
      mountPath: /var/cache/nginx
    - name: var-run
      mountPath: /var/run
  volumes:
  - name: tmp-volume
    emptyDir: {}
  - name: var-cache-nginx
    emptyDir: {}
  - name: var-run
    emptyDir: {}
